notes.title: The full version is Now Released! 🥳
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Monuments Renovators! 🏛️[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257280/Monuments_Renovator/

[h3][b]The long-awaited moment has just arrived and the game is available in its full version! 🥳[/b][/h3]

Our journey together lasted over a year through Early Access, during which time we received a lot of valuable information and feedback from you, which helped us direct the full version of Monuments Renovator. 😊

🔸 For players who decided to support us in Early Access, you don't have to do anything, you will only receive an update notification, which will give you the full version of the game.

🔸 For players who are joining us now, we have prepared several bundles with our partners, you can find the full list here -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/666c79ebd030fcf190efb700f9db9cd68c901d46.png[/img]

[h3][b][u]The key differences that you can already see in the full version of the game are:[/u][/b][/h3][h3]1. Three new locations Great Wall, Luxor, Machu Picchu
2. Mini museum where we set the rewards obtained for completing the location
3. Tool repairs
4. Bug correction and optimization
5. GUI renewal[/h3]

Thank you once again for your contribution to the development of Monuments Renovator and we can only invite you to play the full version of the game!

[previewyoutube=RDpoDZz-Cwg;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://discord.gg/Gn6SpRueuK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
Monuments Renovator Team

notes.title: Update For June 14th
notes.content:
List of changelogs:
- Improved stone block weight and catching
- Fixed progress bar
- Added ability to pick items from under the table
- Loading bug fixed
- Added M manu icons visible all the time as well as ALT icon to enter AR
- Added the ability to change the size of the cursor

Now, by opening the wheel menu, we can click on the task we want in the right corner of the screen and the game will show us with the help of the indicator where this task is located on the location. By clicking on the green areas with the name of the main task, for example: Check area, we can close the task guidelines list or open it, which organizes the list of sentences.
